title: Risk Management in Media Translation: Watching America as a Case Study
core_idea: Use a risk-management framework to analyze translational decisions at macro and micro (institutional and individual) levels in a corpus of Arabic newspaper articles translated into English on the Watching America website, focusing on how volunteer translators manage risks affecting the translations' communicative function and relationships among participants.
tldr: A study that analyzes how volunteer translators on Watching America make institutional and individual decisions to manage risks in Arabic-to-English media translation, using qualitative and quantitative methods within a risk-management framework.
